request.raw_text: If this is a spanner, the main cutout is too deep which is weakening the tool. Make the cutout shallower by 10mm, but keep the "size" of the spanner the same - meaning the parallel surfaces remain 20mm apart.

areas_to_change.action: Reduce the depth of the open-ended jaw cutout by 10 mm while retaining its 20 mm width.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The main U-shaped cutout in the open end of the spanner, including its closed throat and two parallel internal jaw surfaces.
areas_to_change.location: Large open-ended head opposite the circular ring end.
areas_to_change.description: Move the closed, rounded throat of the jaw cutout 10 mm toward the open mouth, making the cutout shallower. Extend or reconstruct the throat transition as needed while keeping the two opposing parallel jaw surfaces 20 mm apart.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Maintain a perpendicular separation of exactly 20 mm; do not change the functional spanner size.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Outer profile of the open-ended head
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the external head diameter, jaw-tip positions, and overall outline except where the internal throat is made shallower.
Preserve their length, width, thickness, position, and profile.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Circular ring end and its through-hole
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the outer ring profile, hole diameter, location, and through condition.
Keep the existing extrusion thickness and all side faces unchanged.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The open jaw remains 20 mm wide between its parallel gripping flats, but its internal slot terminates 10 mm closer to the mouth, leaving more material at the throat and handle-to-head transition.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The spanner continues to fit the same 20 mm nominal fastener size while gaining a stronger open-end throat.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The increased material behind the jaw reduces local bending stress and the likelihood of spreading or failure under load, although insertion depth around a fastener is reduced by 10 mm.

ambiguities.description: The datum and direction used to measure the 10 mm reduction in cutout depth are not explicitly stated.
candidate_interpretations: Move the deepest point of the rounded throat 10 mm toward the open jaw tips while keeping the mouth and 20 mm jaw width fixed.
Shorten only the straight parallel portions of the cutout by 10 mm and preserve the existing throat radius.
Offset the complete closed throat boundary toward the mouth by 10 mm, adjusting its blends into the parallel surfaces.

ambiguities.description: The request does not state whether the existing throat radius must be preserved.
candidate_interpretations: Preserve the existing throat radius and translate it toward the mouth.
Allow the throat radius or blend geometry to change as needed while maintaining the 20 mm spacing.
